# Bitola revolutionary district

The Bitola revolutionary district (Macedonian/Bulgarian: Битолски револуционерен округ) was an organizational grouping of the Internal Macedonian-Adrianople Revolutionary Organization. The most famous leaders of the group were Pere Toshev, Gyorche Petrov and Boris Sarafov. This rebel group was active in western parts of Aegean Macedonia and Vardar Macedonia with headquarters in Bitola.
